mapper.select: SELECT id, local_id, api_code, id_card, cell, cus_num, usertype, `name`, pd_cell_type, pd_cell_province, device_add_status, push_status, `status`, is_del, create_time, update_time, extend, data_message, create_date FROM b_umeng_data WHERE id > #{lastSearchId} AND local_id in (0,#{localId}) AND api_code =#{apiCode} AND device_add_status in (-1,1) AND status = 1 AND is_del = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{searchSize}

select bud.id, bud.local_id, bud.api_code, bud.id_card, bud.cell, bud.cus_num, bud.usertype, bud.`name`, bud.pd_cell_type, bud.pd_cell_province, bud.device_add_status, bud.push_status, bud.`status`, bud.is_del, bud.create_time, bud.update_time, bud.extend,bud.data_message, bud.create_date from b_umeng_data bud inner join b_umeng_interface_log bulog on bud.local_id = bulog .local_id and bud.cell = bulog.phone_sha256 where bud.id > #{lastSearchId} and bud.local_id = #{localId} and bud.api_code = #{apiCode} and bud.push_status in (-1, 1) and bud.status =1 and bud.is_del = 1 and bulog.local_id = #{localId} and bulog.request_type = 3 and bulog.event_type in(22, 1001) order by bud.id asc limit #{searchSize};
